meta.name: compound-engineering
meta.description: Make your AI agent learn and improve automatically. Reviews sessions, extracts learnings, updates memory files, and compounds knowledge over time. Set up nightly review loops that make your agent smarter every day.

copy.tagline: 让AI助手每晚自动复盘学习，持续积累知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI助手能自动从对话中学习并不断进步
copy.tagline_en: Make your AI agent learn and improve automatically every night
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to automatically learn from sessions and get smarter over time

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动回顾过去24小时的工作，提取学到的经验、模式、偏好和待办事项，并更新记忆文件。这样，Claude 每天都会变得更聪明。
howto.when: 每晚10:30自动触发回顾，或当你手动要求“回顾过去24小时的工作”时触发。

say.text: 回顾过去24小时的工作，提取学到的经验。
say.note: Claude 会扫描会话并更新记忆文件。
Claude 会生成当前小时的记忆摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically reviews the last 24 hours of work, extracts learnings, patterns, preferences, and todos, and updates memory files. This makes Claude smarter each day.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically at 10:30 PM nightly, or when you manually ask to review the last 24 hours of work.

say_en.text: Review the last 24 hours of work and extract learnings.
say_en.note: Claude will scan sessions and update memory files.
Claude will generate a summary for the current hour.
